import Effect4

/-!
A module the audited tree contains and no admission names. Compiled on its own
and imported by the probe root, so the gate reads it as an ordinary member of
the tree rather than as part of the file being elaborated — a constant declared
in the root itself has no module and is never audited.

The module is `Test.PlantedChoice` and the namespace is
`Test.Audit.PlantedChoice`. The mismatch is the point: `Test.Audit`
is where the admitted audit-implementation modules live, and declaring into
that namespace from outside must buy nothing. Admission follows the module.
-/

namespace Test.Audit.PlantedChoice

noncomputable def plantedUnadmittedChoice : Nat :=
  Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Nat)

end Test.Audit.PlantedChoice
